title: Canvas Snake
prompt: Build a polished browser Snake game with keyboard and touch controls, scoring, pause/resume, restart, increasing difficulty, collision handling, and responsive canvas layout. The result must run locally without paid services.
acceptanceCriteria: Game starts from a clear title or ready state.
Arrow keys, WASD, and touch controls work without page scrolling issues.
Snake movement, apple spawning, growth, scoring, self collision, wall collision, restart, pause, and difficulty changes work correctly.
Layout is responsive from phone width to desktop width.
Visuals are polished enough for a user to judge immediately from a screenshot or live preview.
Project includes simple run instructions and at least one automated or scripted sanity check.
requiredArtifacts: preview URL or local run command
